name: Rowan Freemaker's lightsaber
description: Rowan Freemaker's lightsaber was a Jedi weapon used by the Sith agent Naare and the Force-sensitive Rowan Freemaker during the search for the Kyber Saber crystals. Rowan stole this lightsaber from Naare during a duel on Naboo. Rowan used the blue lightsaber to hone his training as a Jedi under the tutelage of the former Sith clone Jek-14 and the B1-series battle droid Roger. Rowan later used the blade to fight Naare during a duel at the Freemaker Garage. Later, he would use it to fight M-OC.
